# `@planroom/ui`

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED by cargo xtask gen from docs/contributing/repo-layout.md's area tables; do not edit -->

This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** design tokens (TS and CSS variables, light and dark), view-model rows, hotkey and row-key assignment, truncation, the display-sanitizing pass [DR-64], the braille raster, the machine stepper.
- **May depend on:** `@planroom/contract`; no third-party package.
- **Must not:** React, the DOM, Node APIs, directly or through a third-party package.
- **How to test it:** vitest; `machine_step_parity` against Rust golden outputs; `display_parity` against the engine's golden table; `contrast_meets_the_bar` over the tokens.

Read first, from [Repo layout](../../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#read-first-per-area):

- **Sections:** [How all three render the same output](../../docs/contributing/architecture.md#how-all-three-render-the-same-output); [Design language](../../docs/contributing/design-language.md).
- **Records:** [DR-21](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-21-agent-first-envelope-and-engine-authored-strings), [DR-64](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-64-agents-never-hold-the-persons-authority), [DR-77](../../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-77-every-pane-action-within-two-keys-and-an-artifact-that-serves-a-cloud-session).
- **Scenarios:** S9, S13.
